description: Single source of truth. Python: pipeline.common.project_config.

seeds.description: Split uses create_split_random_state (42). Encoder/LLM stages use random_state.

split_layout.description: 8/1/1 = 80% train / 10% validation / 10% test (811). CSVs: train.csv, validation.csv, test.csv.

training.description: RoBERTa-family fine-tune defaults (shared baseline / distill / Slurm).

hpc.description: Optional local defaults only — not used at runtime. Set HPC_USER, HPC_HOST, and ECHOHATE_HPC_PROFILE in your shell.

data_layout.description: Submit/sync defaults (ECHOHATE_DATA_SEED_DIR, DATASET). Empty default_data_seed_dir => seed_<random_state>.

dataset_tasks.description: LLM prompt task per dataset. default=hate; SBIC uses offensive (OFFENSIVE/NOT_OFFENSIVE).
